notes.title: RefRain: Ver.1.03.5 update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24404908/7eae04a2da3ab587b867a6463c5087bbb537f535.png[/img]
Today's update is mainly under the hood fixes, but it should alleiviate slowdown issues some of you were seeing.
[list][*]Added DirectX9 Support
This should fix slowdown some users were experiencing (most on laptops with graphic cards using nVidia Optimus Technology and a CPU with an internal GPU)
[*]Added .NET Framework 3.5 compatible
In order to make SSL communication possible
[*]Fixed font for some users
Some users were not seeing the correct fonts displayed and this should fix that.
[/list]

notes.title: Cyberpunk Shoot-’em-up, RefRain -prism memories-, Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://d289qh4hsbjjw7.cloudfront.net/gameliner-jp-official-20151124020045378/files/refrain_warningwatermark.gif[/img]
"WARNING! The Enemy is Approaching Fast!" (What does that remind you of?  [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/377870/]Dariusburst Chronicle Saviors[/url])

Degica Games is pleased to announce that RebRank’s cyberpunk shoot-’em-up, RefRain -prism memories-, is now available on Steam!...
store.steampowered.com/app/435970

HELLO, WORLD! RESTART… BOOT…

WAKEUP SYSTEM << M.R.S. >>
VIRTUAL CONTROL CONNECT… [OK]

LOGIN… [OK] CONSOLE... [OK]

DIVE SUCCESS!

RefRain -prism memories- is an empowering, cyberpunk, bullet-hell shoot-’em-up that focuses on fast-paced, offensive gameplay. “Dive” into a hazardous digital world, cycle through 3 different attack modes, and delete the opposition with superior firepower.

View the RefRain -prism memories- trailer here…
www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgOTrWpL3G4

RefRain -prism memories- is different. Yes, it’s technically a “bullet-hell shoot-’em-up”, but you’ll find yourself feeling much more powerful than the average game in that genre. Here's why...

[img]https://d289qh4hsbjjw7.cloudfront.net/gameliner-jp-official-20151124020045378/files/refrain_Pattern2.gif[/img]

[olist]
[*]You’ve got three different ships to choose from: the balanced Must Viper, the close-range Blitz Lester, and the sniping Bronx Terror, so you don’t have to always adhere to the same old strategy. 
[*]Dodging bullets is still important but less so once you learn how the game’s three attack modes work together…
http://blog.degigames.com/preview/refrain-preview-feed-the-cycle-destroy-your-enemies/
[*]The expertly designed enemies and bullet patterns challenge you but reward skillful and aggressive play.
[/olist]

What this all ultimately means is that boss fights can feel like even one-on-one duels rather than desperate struggles.

You'll be immersed. RefRain’s art is high-resolution and beautiful, complementing the game’s rich cyberpunk storyline. Yes, this is a shoot-’em-up game with an intriguing story! Mix those elements with the game’s glowing neon, digital aesthetic and high-octane electronica soundtrack, and you’ll want to “dive” into the world of RefRain -prism memories- yourself.

[img]https://d289qh4hsbjjw7.cloudfront.net/gameliner-jp-official-20151124020045378/files/refrain_conceptwatermarked.gif[/img]

Make that happen today!...
store.steampowered.com/app/435970/

notes.title: Cyberpunk Shoot-’em-up, RefRain -prism memories-, Coming to Steam on May 12th!
notes.content:
HELLO, WORLD! RESTART… BOOT…
 
WAKEUP SYSTEM << M.R.S. >>
VIRTUAL CONTROL CONNECT… [OK]
 
LOGIN… [OK] CONSOLE... [OK]

DIVE SUCCESS!

(Serious hacker voice) We're in! Degica is pleased to announce that RebRank’s cyberpunk shoot-’em-up, RefRain -prism memories-, is coming to Steam on May 12th. Put on your mirror shades and punch deck because it's time to get cyberpunk! Ok, ok, so RefRain's tone is a bit more serious than that, but let us have our fun, eh?

RefRain -prism memories- is an empowering, cyberpunk, bullet-hell shoot-’em-up that focuses on fast-paced, offensive gameplay. “Dive” into a hazardous digital world, cycle through 3 different attack modes, and delete the opposition with superior firepower.
 
Hackers must make difficult choices. Choose between three ships and dive in with their unique attacks: the balanced Must Viper, the close-range Blitz Lester, and the sniping Bronx Terror.

Hackers must be tactical. Tactically use your Concept Reactor to turn harmful projectiles into prisms that you can shoot to increase your M.E.F.A2 gauge and unleash devastating special attacks, then repeat the cycle with deadly efficiency.

Hackers must love what they do. Expertly designed enemies and bullet patterns challenge you but reward skillful and aggressive play. Beautiful high-resolution character art will dance on your retinas while the high-octane electronica soundtrack quickens your pulse.
 
Hackers... simply... must.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/435970
Jack the baddies up before they jack you out! Is that burning gray matter I smell?

Put on your mirror shades and punch deck because it's time to get cyberpunk! Ok, ok, so RefRain's tone is a bit more serious than that, but let us have our fun, eh?

RefRain -prism memories- is an empowering, cyberpunk, bullet-hell shoot-’em-up that focuses on fast-paced, offensive gameplay. “Dive” into a hazardous digital world, cycle through 3 different attack modes, and delete the opposition with superior firepower.
 
Hackers must make difficult choices. Choose between three ships and dive in with their unique attacks: the balanced Must Viper, the close-range Blitz Lester, and the sniping Bronx Terror.

Hackers must be tactical. Tactically use your Concept Reactor to turn harmful projectiles into prisms that you can shoot to increase your M.E.F.A2 gauge and unleash devastating special attacks, then repeat the cycle with deadly efficiency.

Hackers must love what they do. Expertly designed enemies and bullet patterns challenge you but reward skillful and aggressive play. Beautiful high-resolution character art will dance on your retinas while the high-octane electronica soundtrack quickens your pulse.
 
Hackers... simply... must.
